Gantt.name: Gantt
Gantt.description: Reusable accessors-based Gantt chart with collapsible sticky title rail (mobile defaults collapsed), scrollable timeline, unit-aware snap move/resize, in-bar titles when the rail is collapsed or off, optional overflow edge chips (off while the expanded title rail is visible; on when collapsed or rail off), hover datetime labels, dependency SVG (showDependencies), connection dots (onDependencyChange && !readOnly), now line, view-range + search + filter toolbar, and optional create strip — all regions slottable for downstream overrides. Search/filter are controlled presentation; downstream owns item matching.

items.name: items
items.description: Timeline items of any domain shape.

accessors.name: accessors
accessors.description: Accessors mapping domain fields → Gantt geometry. Defaults to standard JSON task fields (`id`, `start`, `end`, `label`, `color`, `dependencies`).

viewRange.name: viewRange
viewRange.description: Controlled or initial view range. Default: 'month'.

showToolbar.name: showToolbar
showToolbar.description: Show toolbar (view-range + search + filter). Default: true.

showRail.name: showRail
showRail.description: Show the sticky title/rail column. Default: true. When true, overflow edge chips stay off unless showEdgeChips is forced on.

showDependencies.name: showDependencies
showDependencies.description: Show dependency SVG layer (independent of readOnly / onDependencyChange). Default: false.

searchValue.name: searchValue
searchValue.description: Controlled search string for the default toolbar. Presentation only — filter `items` yourself (or use `filterGanttItems`).

filters.name: filters
filters.description: Controlled filter map for the default toolbar popover. Presentation only — downstream owns matching against `items`.

filterFields.name: filterFields
filterFields.description: Filter field definitions shown in the default filter popover. Add a custom field by appending to this array (key/label/type[+options/getValue]).

showSearch.name: showSearch
showSearch.description: Show search input in the default toolbar. Default: true.

showFilter.name: showFilter
showFilter.description: Show filter trigger + popover in the default toolbar. Default: true.

railCollapsed.name: railCollapsed
railCollapsed.description: Controlled collapsed state for the title/rail column. When collapsed, the rail shrinks to an icon strip and bar titles render in-bar.

defaultRailCollapsed.name: defaultRailCollapsed
defaultRailCollapsed.description: Uncontrolled initial collapsed state. When omitted, defaults to `true` on mobile viewports (`useIsMobile`, 768px) and `false` on desktop — only when `showRail` is true. Ignored when `railCollapsed` is controlled.

showEdgeChips.name: showEdgeChips
showEdgeChips.description: Show overflow edge chips when a bar is clipped by the viewport. Default: false when the expanded title rail is visible; true when the rail is hidden or collapsed (rail overflow arrows hide with labels). Still overridable.

children.name: children
children.description: Compound composition children. When omitted, the default anatomy renders (toolbar + header + rail + rows + grid + now line + optional create strip).

maxHeight.name: maxHeight
maxHeight.description: Max height of the scroll viewport.

railWidth.name: railWidth
railWidth.description: Sticky rail width. Default: 12rem. Ignored when showRail is false.

onItemChange.description: Called when a bar move/resize commits new dates.

onDependencyChange.description: Called when a dependency edge is added or removed.

onCreate.name: onCreate
onCreate.description: Called when the bottom create strip commits a new range. When provided, the create strip renders automatically (fail-closed otherwise omitted).

onSearchChange.name: onSearchChange
onSearchChange.description: Search change callback. UI still renders when omitted (no-op).

ChartTooltipHandlers.rawDefinition:
export interface ChartTooltipHandlers {
  showTooltip: (content: React.ReactNode, options?: { event?: any; position?: [number, number]; anchor?: TooltipAnchor | string; datum?: any }) => void
  showTooltipFromEvent: (content: React.ReactNode, event: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent | any, options?: { anchor?: TooltipAnchor | string; datum?: any }) => void
  showTooltipAt: (content: React.ReactNode, position: [number, number], anchor?: string, datum?: any) => void
  hideTooltip: (immediate?: boolean | number, delayMs?: number) => void
  updatePosition: (x: number, y: number) => void
  tooltipStore: TooltipStore
  tooltipState: TooltipState
  /**
   * Generates mouse and focus event props to bind directly to SVG or HTML chart elements.
   */
  bindTooltipEvents: <T = any>(options: {
    datum: T
    tooltip?: React.ComponentType<any> | ((props: any) => React.ReactNode)
    isInteractive?: boolean
    anchor?: TooltipAnchor | string
    onMouseEnter?: (datum: T, event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onMouseMove?: (datum: T, event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onMouseLeave?: (datum: T, event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onClick?: (datum: T, event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onFocus?: (datum: T, event: React.FocusEvent) => void
    onBlur?: (datum: T, event: React.FocusEvent) => void
  }) => {
    onMouseEnter?: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onMouseMove?: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onMouseLeave?: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void
    onFocus?: (event: React.FocusEvent) => void
    onBlur?: (event: React.FocusEvent) => void
  }
}

TooltipStore.rawDefinition:
export interface TooltipStore {
  getState: () => TooltipState
  subscribe: (listener: (state: TooltipState) => void) => () => void
  showTooltip: (content: React.ReactNode, options?: ShowTooltipOptions) => void
  showTooltipFromEvent: (content: React.ReactNode, event: any, options?: ShowTooltipOptions) => void
  showTooltipAt: (content: React.ReactNode, position: [number, number], anchor?: string, datum?: any) => void
  hideTooltip: (immediate?: boolean, delayMs?: number) => void
  updatePosition: (x: number, y: number) => void
  onCanvasPointerEnter: (event: React.PointerEvent | React.MouseEvent) => void
  onCanvasPointerMove: (event: React.PointerEvent | React.MouseEvent) => void
  onCanvasPointerLeave: (event?: React.PointerEvent | React.MouseEvent) => void
  setCanvasRef: (element: HTMLElement | null) => void
  setOptions: (options: TooltipStoreOptions) => void
  destroy: () => void
}

export interface ThemeContextValue {
  /* --- Unified Mode Management --- */
  mode: ThemeMode
  resolvedMode: 'light' | 'dark'
  setMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void

  /* --- Unified Preset Registry --- */
  presetId: string
  setPresetId: (id: string) => void
  presets: ThemePreset[]
  activePreset: ThemePreset
  registerPreset: (preset: ThemePreset) => void
  unregisterPreset: (id: string) => void

  /* --- Universal Token Engine (Pure Token-Driven Persistence & Granularity) --- */
  tokens: TokenMap
  getToken: (key: string) => string | number | undefined
  setToken: (key: string, value: string | number) => void
  setTokens: (tokens: TokenMap) => void
  removeToken: (key: string) => void
  resetTokens: () => void

  /* --- Token Descriptors (Tooling & Editor Discovery) --- */
  descriptors: TokenDescriptor[]
  registerDescriptors: (descriptors: TokenDescriptor[]) => void

  /* --- Global Reset --- */
  resetTheme: () => void

  /* --- Optical Token Convenience Helpers (Direct Token Projections) --- */
  radius: RadiusPreset | string
  setRadius: (radius: RadiusPreset | string) => void
  shadow: ShadowPreset | string
  setShadow: (shadow: ShadowPreset | string) => void
  density: DensityPreset | number
  setDensity: (density: DensityPreset | number) => void
  stroke: StrokePreset | string
  setStroke: (stroke: StrokePreset | string) => void
  fontSize: FontSizePreset | string
  setFontSize: (size: FontSizePreset | string) => void
  fontFamily: string
  setFontFamily: (font: string) => void
  fontFamilyMono: string
  setFontFamilyMono: (font: string) => void
}
